title: Cipher and Drop
author: Sebastian Villalobos
blurb: Felix Yarrow, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
